title: The Football Match
description: A boy plays in an exciting football match.
instructions: Read the text about a football match, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: On Saturday, Carlos played in a football match. His team is called the Blue Stars. They played against the Red Lions.
The match started at ten o'clock. The Red Lions scored first. Then Carlos kicked the ball into the net. The score was one to one.
In the last minute, Carlos's friend Ali scored a goal. The Blue Stars won the match two to one. The players were very excited and they jumped up and down.

After the match, the coach, Mr Silva, talked to the team. He said, 'Well done, everyone! You played very well today.' Then he gave each player a bottle of cold water. The players sat on the grass and drank it.
Carlos's parents and his little sister watched the match. His sister had a blue flag. She waved it and shouted, 'Go, Blue Stars!' After the game, she gave Carlos a big hug.
The family went to a cafe for lunch. Carlos was very hungry. He ate a big burger and some chips. His dad said, 'You are a star, Carlos!' Carlos smiled, but he said, 'Ali is the star today!'

The Blue Stars practise every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Their next match is in two weeks. They will play against the Green Tigers. The Green Tigers are a very good team. Carlos wants to score two goals next time.
